events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A truly groundbreaking album, but does it still hold up as one of their best?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Impact
angles.copy: A true visionary gone too soon. John Lennon's music and message continue to resonate. Which of his songs means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The music world remembers David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: Eighty years since his birth, David Bowie's artistry is still inspiring generations. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. His legacy is undeniable. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist, songwriter, and producer, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the iconic Jimmy Page! The riffs he gave us are still sending shivers down spines. What's his greatest guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the 82nd birthday of the inimitable Sir Rod Stewart, a true rock and pop icon.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Sir Rod Stewart is 82 today! That distinctive voice has given us so many classics. Which Rod hit is your all-time favourite?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of British ska legends Madness.

angles.name: One Step Beyond
angles.copy: Sixty-six for Suggs today! The voice of Madness, bringing pure joy and nutty sounds for decades. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' singer, Paul Young.

angles.name: Paul Young's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 71st to Paul Young! That smooth voice defined a generation. What's the Paul Young track that always gets you?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's Reign
angles.copy: Eighty-one and still shining! Happy Birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton. From 'Jolene' to Dollywood, what's your favourite thing about Dolly?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's lead singer, songwriter, and national treasure, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Gary's Tunes
angles.copy: Fifty-six today for the one and only Gary Barlow! So many hits, so many memories. What's your favourite Gary Barlow or Take That song?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Seventy-seven for Billy Ocean! His smooth sound gave us some absolute gems. What's your favourite Billy Ocean classic?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's First Induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first-ever induction ceremony, honouring legends like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame inductions. Who do you think was the most deserving of that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen.

angles.name: Mark's Milestone
angles.copy: Fifty-five for Mark Owen today! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's done it all. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live show on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an iconic way to say goodbye! What's your favourite moment from that famous gig?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the legendary drummer, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Seventy-six today for the incomparable Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo superstardom, his drum fills are legendary. What's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Forty-six today for JT! From *NSYNC to solo smash hits, he's been bringing the moves and the tunes for decades. What's your favourite Justin Timberlake song?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the beloved British actor Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Eighty-seven today for the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Frost, he's given us so many iconic characters. What's your favourite David Jason role?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959.

angles.name: Music's Tragic Loss
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, we lost three incredible talents on 'The Day The Music Died'. Their songs live on forever. Which artist's music from that era still resonates most with you?

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to the 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer, Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Sixty-one today for Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' on his infectious pop. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Remembering the reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Eighty-two years since his birth, Bob Marley's message of peace and unity is as powerful as ever. What's your favourite Bob Marley anthem?

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 85th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter Carole King.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Eighty-five today for the incredible Carole King! A songwriting powerhouse who also delivered 'Tapestry'. What's your favourite Carole King song, whether she wrote it or sang it?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the iconic Whitney Houston, who would have been 64.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's power and emotion are still unmatched. What's your favourite Whitney ballad?

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 31 years since the devastating news that Take That were splitting up, leaving a generation heartbroken.

angles.name: Never Forget
angles.copy: Thirty-one years ago, the pop world wept as Take That announced their split. Were you amongst the heartbroken? What was your reaction?

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Sixty-eight today for Ali Campbell! The voice behind so many UB40 hits. What's your favourite track from the reggae legends?

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to global superstar Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Perfect Pop
angles.copy: Thirty-six today for Ed Sheeran! From busking to stadium tours, he's captured hearts worldwide. What's your favourite Ed Sheeran song?

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Remembering The Beatles' 'Quiet Beatle', George Harrison, who would have celebrated his 84th birthday today.

angles.name: My Sweet Lord
angles.copy: Eighty-four years since his birth, celebrating the life and music of George Harrison. What's your favourite George solo track or Beatles contribution?

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary frontman of The Who, Roger Daltrey.

angles.name: Who's Next?
angles.copy: Eighty-three today for Roger Daltrey! The voice of The Who, still rocking after all these years. What's your favourite Who anthem?

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 69th birthday to the iconic 80s singer-songwriter Nik Kershaw.

angles.name: Wouldn't It Be Good
angles.copy: Sixty-nine today for Nik Kershaw! His 80s hits are still absolute bangers. What's your go-to Nik Kershaw track?
